Gajab ka Campus Ambassador — Lead. Earn. Get Recognized.

You're not applying for a job. You're stepping into a leadership role at one of India's most exciting e-commerce startups.

As a Gajab Ka Campus Ambassador, you'll build the brand on your campus, earn commission on every order (no upper cap), and grow into a City Head managing operations across your city.

Before you apply, we strongly recommend downloading the Gajab app and exploring it. It'll give you a clear understanding of the product you'll be representing on your campus.

👉 Download the app: https://gajab.go.link/bfR8p

Please note:

  • ⏱️ This form takes just 10–15 minutes. Be honest — we're looking for drive, not perfection.
  • 🔒 Limited seats per city. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
  • 📩 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 5 business days.
